description: Task-based routing, inherited model, and complete outcome verification.

evals.name: frontier-session-runs-the-contract
evals.prompt: /ultrapex -s add per-route rate limiting to the API gateway — config-driven limits, middleware, and tests
evals.expected_output: On the inherited session model the skill runs the five-invariant flow end to end: reads the touched code paths before editing, commits to an approach (pausing only at a genuine fork), builds within scope, verifies adversarially with fresh-context refuter subagents scaled to the blast radius, and saves a grounded report (Outcome / Changes / Verification / Open items) to ~/.agents/output/{project}/ultrapex/, reporting the expanded path.

evals.name: inherits-model-without-capability-guess
evals.expected_output: Use the explicitly selected adaptive workflow with the inherited model and actual host tools. Do not refuse based on a model label. Without independent agents, report the lower independence of a shared-context self-check.

evals.name: planning-only-routes-to-forge
evals.prompt: /ultrapex should we move sessions from Redis to Postgres, or keep Redis and add persistence?
evals.expected_output: Option-weighing with no build mandate is out of scope: the skill declines implementation framing and redirects to /forge for the research-and-decide pass, offering to return via ultrapex -f once a plan artifact exists.

evals.name: trivial-task-routes-to-oneshot
evals.prompt: /ultrapex fix the typo in the README install command
evals.expected_output: Complete the trivial edit through the focused Oneshot workflow without a new permission gate or unnecessary independent-agent work.
